body: **Foco:** Advanced passive modality — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (pensamento crítico).
**Texto do dia:** resenha / review.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar a voz passiva com modais e estruturas de relato (is said to, ought to have been, can be seen) ao ouvir uma resenha.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: resumo do enredo em uma frase

blocks.title: Review: “The Lost Manuscript”
paras: This novel **is said to have been** inspired by a real discovery. The plot **can be summarized** in one line: a forgotten manuscript **must be found** before it **is destroyed**. Some twists **ought to have been cut**; the middle **could have been shortened**.
The author **is believed to be** working on a sequel, which **is expected to appear** next year. Overall, it **should be read** for its atmosphere.

items.q: The novel is said to be inspired by a real discovery.
items.why: is said to have been inspired.

items.q: The reviewer thinks nothing should be cut.
A sequel is expected next year.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: Some twists **ought to have been cut**.
The author **is believed to be** writing a sequel.
It **is said to have been** inspired by a true story.

blocks.body: **Modal + be + particípio** (presente/futuro) e **modal + have been + particípio** (passado). Com *say, believe, expect*, use **is said to**.
Perfect: *is said to have been* (passado) × *is said to be* (presente).

items.s: The plot ___ summarized in one line. (can)
Some twists ought ___ have been cut. (to)
The author ___ believed to be writing. (is)
It is said to ___ been inspired by real events. (have)

body: **Rumor has it.** — Corre o boato.
**It goes without saying.** — Nem é preciso dizer.
**So it is said.** — Assim se diz.
**Page-turner.** — Livro que prende.
**Judge a book by its cover.** — Julgar pelas aparências.
**Read the riot act.** — Dar uma bronca.
**A hard act to follow.** — Difícil de superar.
**By all accounts,…** — Segundo todos os relatos,…
**Word on the street.** — O que se comenta.
**Will there be a sequel?** — Haverá continuação?
**One is expected next year.** — Espera-se uma no próximo ano.
**Is the novel based on a true story?** — O romance é baseado em história real?

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça uma pausa curta entre grupos de sentido e acelere as palavras fracas entre os acentos.
words: The argument, | on closer inspection, | falls apart.
It is said | to have been written | in 1850.
What matters | is not the claim | but the proof.

prompts.model: The story can be told in a sentence.
The ending ought to have been shorter.
The author is said to live in Lisbon.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences about a film or book using passive modality.
blocks.model: The film is said to have been shot in one month. The plot can be summarized in one line. The ending ought to have been changed. A sequel is expected to be announced soon. It should be seen on a big screen.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
